assumptions: The ask covers health data in patients, appointments and clinical_notes and endpoints that touch them, not the whole workspace
phi is the right tag name for health data, per the recipe. It does not exist in the workspace yet
The template's default public exemption (except_tags public) is correct for AUTH-010, and the public tag is the workspace's real exemption tag

ssn, dob, diagnosis, note and insurance_member_id are the health-data fields. Other fields such as email, phone, address and first_name were left out to keep the set to health data; the owner may want them added
The HIPAA ask is best served by advisory policies that the owner can later make blocking
parse_errors_seen: CONF-010.R1: table_tags "phi" is on no table in this workspace, so no access to it is judged (warning, not an error; the policy parses)
why_confidence: All nine policy files parse and every name they use exists in the workspace, except the phi tag. The policies cover the health-data checks the catalogue supports for these tables: auth, field marking, output, logs, TLS, saved views and the audit log. Two parts of the ask are not covered and are flagged: the phi tag must be added before CONF-010 and CONF-012 judge anything, and there is no access-log function, so reads of health data are not recorded. Vendors, retention and organisational controls are out of reach. I have not run xano policy evaluate, so the predicted findings are unverified.
